title: Chapter 2 · The castle's song
description: bubbaloo-light comes in from a random point at the castle on the Rec Comtal school, haunted as much as the castle is threatening: everything at threat 1, less inside the palace after two ánimas. The overlay is the scenario's, not the game's: it prints the song, its position and the haunt level. Then it plays the take from 785 s so it wraps to another point, level-matched, and logs both loudnesses. The last step renders each haunt sound offline and logs its loudness (SCREENSHOT_DEBUG=1). It plays music, so run it with --chrome: just screenshots castle-music --chrome.

steps.eval: window.showMusic = () => { let el = document.querySelector('#music-check'); if (!el) { el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'music-check'; el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:99;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#000c;color:#ffd6ec;font:14px/1.4 monospace'; document.body.append(el); } const m = window.gerard.music; el.textContent = `♪ ${m.playing} · ${m.position()?.toFixed(1)} s · haunt ${m.haunted?.level.toFixed(2) ?? '—'}`; }

steps.caption: Threat 1 at the school: bubbaloo-light from a random point, fully haunted (drone, draught, thunder, sag, heartbeat)
Two ánimas (threat 0.7), inside the palace: the same take plays on, less haunted (thunder and bell still, no sag or heartbeat)

steps.eval: (() => { const at = t => window.loudMap.db[Math.floor(t)]; const after = window.gerard.music.position(); console.log('WRAP', `from ${window.before.toFixed(1)} s (${at(window.before)} dB) to ${after.toFixed(1)} s (${at(after)} dB), median ${[...window.loudMap.db].sort((a, b) => a - b)[window.loudMap.db.length >> 1]} dB`); window.showMusic(); })()

steps.caption: Near the file's end the take crossfades into another point of similar loudness, matched in gain and easing back over 20 s

steps.eval: import('/src/haunt.ts').then(async ({ createHaunt }) => { const measure = buffer => { const d = buffer.getChannelData(0); let peak = 0, sum = 0, n = 0; for (const v of d) { peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v)); if (Math.abs(v) > 1e-3) { sum += v * v; n++; } } return `peak ${peak.toFixed(3)} rms ${Math.sqrt(sum / Math.max(1, n)).toFixed(4)}`; }; for (const id of ['music-box', 'breath', 'bell', 'thunder', 'heartbeat']) { const c = new OfflineAudioContext(2, 48000 * 14, 48000); createHaunt(c, c.destination).sound(id); console.log('HAUNT', id, measure(await c.startRendering())); } const c = new OfflineAudioContext(2, 48000 * 8, 48000); createHaunt(c, c.destination).set(1, .03); console.log('HAUNT beds at 1', measure(await c.startRendering())); })
